feature: iOS ATT前 무료 광고 안내 팝업
sequence: If notDetermined, show the MotionFit explanation
Request native ATT only if still notDetermined

copy.meaning: MotionFit 무료 기능이 광고로 지원됨을 안내하며, 추적을 거부해도 이용 가능한 기능은 동일함을 명시

safety_and_recovery: Existing shared tracking Future serializes onboarding and ad-init requests; one explanation/ATT flow
Already authorized/denied/restricted/notSupported users and Android do not see the explanation
Missing UI/background/workout/fullscreen ad defers ATT with retryable att_pending; no silent bypass
Acknowledged explanation is retained in memory across unresolved native ATT retries; OS status decides future prompts
App-open loading opportunity cancelled before the explanation; a pending tracking flow blocks another app-open opportunity
Existing UMP and canRequestAds checks unchanged; Continue never substitutes for OS permission or UMP consent

validation.failure: Both new widget tests failed at binding invariant verification because debugDefaultTargetPlatformOverride was restored in outer tearDown, after the binding checked it.
validation.functional_assertions: Both widget test bodies completed their dialog, ordering and layout assertions before the binding invariant failure; their final test status remains FAIL.
validation.fix: Reset the test-only target platform override at the end of each widget test body, before binding verification.
validation.reason_not_rerun: User instruction permits at most one cheap verification step; no repeated test/fix loop.
